name.zh: 历阳—曲阿—吴—会稽（孙策定江东）
name.en: Liyang–Qua–Wu–Kuaiji (Sun Ce takes the Lower Yangtze)

description.zh: 兴平二年（195）孙策自历阳渡江，先破横江、当利，转战牛渚、秣陵，进至曲阿击走刘繇；建安元年（196）破吴郡严白虎，随即引兵渡浙江攻会稽，王朗据固陵抵抗，孙策用孙静之计夜出查渎、突袭高迁屯，王朗败走东冶后投降。孙策自领会稽太守，以朱治为吴郡太守。原线止于吴，线尾无后续；此处补会稽一段。
description.en: In 195 Sun Ce crossed the Yangtze at Liyang, took Hengjiang and Dangli, fought through Niuzhu and Moling and drove Liu Yao from Qua. In 196 he defeated Yan Baihu in Wu commandery, then crossed the Zhejiang against Kuaiji; Wang Lang held Guling until Sun Ce, on Sun Jing’s advice, made a night feint and struck Gaoqian tun, routing Wang Lang, who fled to Dongye and surrendered. Sun Ce took the title of Kuaiji governor and made Zhu Zhi governor of Wu. The former line ended at Wu with no follow-through; the Kuaiji leg is now added.

name.zh: 许昌—官渡—乌巢—仓亭—许昌（官渡与仓亭）

description.zh: 建安四年（199）六月袁绍选精兵十万南进，曹操分兵守官渡；建安五年（200）十月曹操亲率步骑五千夜袭乌巢，烧其粮草，袁军崩溃。建安六年（201）春曹操就谷于安民，四月扬兵河上、击破袁绍仓亭军，九月还许都。原线止于乌巢，线尾无后续；此处补仓亭与还许，构成完整往返。仓亭取今山东阳谷一带代表点，标 approx。
description.en: In the sixth month of 199 Yuan Shao moved south with 100,000 picked troops and Cao Cao divided his forces to hold Guandu. In the tenth month of 200 Cao Cao led 5,000 horse and foot on a night raid on Wuchao, burned Yuan’s grain and broke his army. In the spring of 201 Cao Cao took grain at Anmin, in the fourth month displayed his army on the Yellow River and destroyed Yuan Shao’s Cangting force, and in the ninth month returned to Xuchang. The former line stopped at Wuchao with no follow-through; Cangting and the return are now added. Cangting is represented by the Yanggu area of Shandong and marked approx.

name.zh: 许昌—新野—襄阳—江陵—赤壁（南征荆州）

description.zh: 建安十三年（208）七月曹操南下征荆州；八月刘表卒，九月曹军至新野，刘琮举州投降，曹操轻骑追击刘备于当阳长坂，随后进占江陵，得刘表水军，顺江东下至赤壁。原线由许都直连江陵，把襄阳、新野一段省掉，导致追击段（襄阳—当阳）的线头悬空；此处补新野、襄阳两点。路线为示意。
description.en: In the seventh month of 208 Cao Cao marched south against Jingzhou. Liu Biao died in the eighth month; in the ninth month Cao’s army reached Xinye, Liu Cong surrendered the province, Cao’s light cavalry pursued Liu Bei to Changban at Dangyang, and he then occupied Jiangling, took over Liu Biao’s river fleet and moved east down the Yangtze to Chibi. The former line ran straight from Xuchang to Jiangling, omitting the Xinye–Xiangyang stretch and leaving the pursuit route without a head; both points are now added. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 襄阳—当阳长坂（轻骑追击）

description.zh: 建安十三年（208）九月曹操至襄阳，闻刘备南走，弃辎重，率精骑五千急追，一日一夜行三百余里，在当阳长坂追上并击溃刘备部众；刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑走汉津，会关羽水军退往夏口。此段线头接南征主线（许都—新野—襄阳），线尾由长坂事件承接。
description.en: In the ninth month of 208 Cao Cao reached Xiangyang and, learning that Liu Bei had fled south, abandoned his baggage and led 5,000 picked cavalry in pursuit, covering over 300 li in a day and a night, catching and routing Liu Bei’s force at Changban in Dangyang. Liu Bei abandoned his family and fled with Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun and a few dozen riders to Hanjin, where he joined Guan Yu’s flotilla and withdrew to Xiakou. The head now joins the main southern campaign and the tail is anchored by the Changban event.

name.zh: 寻阳—公安—江陵（吕蒙白衣渡江）

description.zh: 建安二十四年（219）关羽北伐、后方空虚，吕蒙称病还建业，陆逊代屯陆口以骄关羽；关羽撤兵后，吕蒙自寻阳率精兵伏于船中，使白衣摇橹作商贾，昼夜兼行，尽收江边屯候，遂袭公安、江陵，傅士仁、糜芳先后投降，关羽后方尽失。原线起点作陆口，实际出兵地为寻阳；此处改正。寻阳取今九江一带代表点，标 approx。
description.en: In 219, with Guan Yu away on his northern campaign and his rear thinly held, Lu Meng feigned illness and returned to Jianye while Lu Xun took over at Lukou to lull Guan Yu. Once Guan Yu withdrew his troops, Lu Meng set out from Xunyang with picked men hidden in the ships, disguised the rowers as merchants and moved day and night, sweeping up the riverbank watch posts and seizing Gong’an and Jiangling as Fu Shiren and Mi Fang surrendered in turn, stripping Guan Yu of his rear. The former line began at Lukou, but the actual starting point was Xunyang; this is now corrected. Xunyang is represented by the Jiujiang area and marked approx.

name.zh: 皖口—石亭（陆逊迎击曹休）

description.zh: 黄武七年（228）八月孙权至皖口，以陆逊为大都督，朱桓、全琮为左右督，各督三万人迎击曹休；陆逊自为中部，三道俱进，追至夹石，斩获万余。皖口为皖水入江之口，即今安庆市大观区山口乡山口镇村，距安庆城十五华里；原坐标置于今望江、太湖之间，偏西约 50 公里，已改正。石亭地望在今潜山东北（一说怀宁或桐城境），暂取潜山代表点。路线为示意。
description.en: In the eighth month of 228 Sun Quan reached Wankou and made Lu Xun commander-in-chief, with Zhu Huan and Quan Cong as left and right commanders, each with 30,000 men against Cao Xiu; Lu Xun took the centre, advanced in three columns, pursued to Jiashi and killed or captured over 10,000. Wankou, where the Wan river enters the Yangtze, is Shankou village in modern Anqing’s Daguan district, 15 li west of the city; the former coordinate lay between Wangjiang and Taihu, some 50 km to the west, and has been corrected. Shiting is placed north-east of modern Qianshan (some accounts put it in Huaining or Tongcheng), using Qianshan as a representative point. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 洛阳—高平陵—洛阳（高平陵之变）

description.zh: 魏正始十年（249）正月，曹爽兄弟陪魏帝曹芳出洛阳谒高平陵；司马懿乘机在洛阳发动政变，闭城门、占武库、控制禁军，并派人劝曹爽归降。曹爽回洛阳后交出兵权，旋被族诛，司马氏专权自此始。原线止于高平陵，线尾无后续；此处补回洛阳一段。高平陵取洛阳以南代表点，标 approx。
description.en: In the first month of 249 Cao Shuang and his brothers accompanied Emperor Cao Fang out of Luoyang to sacrifice at Gaopingling. Sima Yi seized the moment to stage a coup in Luoyang, closing the gates, seizing the arsenal and controlling the palace guards, then sent envoys to persuade Cao Shuang to submit. Cao Shuang returned to Luoyang, gave up his command and was soon executed with his clan, beginning Sima family rule. The former line ended at Gaopingling with no follow-through; the return to Luoyang is now added. Gaopingling is represented by a point south of Luoyang and marked approx.

name.zh: 武昌—皖口（孙权进驻皖口）

description.zh: 黄武七年（228）五月周鲂诈降诱曹休，八月孙权自武昌进驻皖口（今安庆山口乡），命陆逊迎击。原皖口坐标偏西约 50 公里，已改正。路线为示意。
description.en: In the fifth month of 228 Zhou Fang lured Cao Xiu with a feigned surrender; in the eighth month Sun Quan moved from Wuchang to Wankou (modern Shankou, Anqing) and sent Lu Xun against him. The former Wankou coordinate lay about 50 km west and has been corrected. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 建安二十六年（221）四月，孙权自公安迁都鄂县，改名武昌，以武昌、下雉、寻阳、阳新、柴桑、沙羡六县置武昌郡，以拒刘备东下。至黄龙元年（229）还都建业。路线为示意。
description.en: In the fourth month of 221 Sun Quan moved his capital from Gong’an to E county, renamed it Wuchang, and created Wuchang commandery from six counties including Wuchang, Xiazhi, Xunyang, Yangxin, Chaisang and Shaxian, to face Liu Bei’s eastward advance. In 229 he returned the capital to Jianye. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 曹操自许县西赴洛阳迎献帝，复奉车驾东还许都。路线为示意，具体道路待考。
description.en: Cao Cao went west from Xu to Luoyang to receive Emperor Xian, then escorted the court back east to Xu. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 曹操自许县南征张绣至宛城，张绣先降后叛，曹操败还。路线示意。
description.en: Cao Cao marched south from Xu against Zhang Xiu at Wancheng; Zhang surrendered, revolted, and Cao withdrew in defeat. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 许—白马—延津—官渡（白马延津之战）

description.zh: 曹操自许县北上救白马，解围后沿河西撤，于延津诱斩文丑，还军官渡。路线示意。
description.en: Cao Cao marched north from Xu to relieve Baima, withdrew along the river, lured and killed Wen Chou at Yanjin, and returned to Guandu. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 赤壁—江陵—襄阳—许（曹操北还）

description.zh: 赤壁败后，曹操自华容道退至江陵，留曹仁守江陵，自率主力北还襄阳、许县。路线示意。
description.en: After the defeat at Red Cliffs Cao Cao withdrew through Huarong to Jiangling, left Cao Ren to hold the city, and led the main force north through Xiangyang to Xu. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 曹操卒于洛阳，灵柩运回邺城，葬于高陵（今河南安阳安丰乡一带）。路线示意。
description.en: Cao Cao died at Luoyang; his coffin was carried back to Ye and buried at Gaoling (near modern Anfeng, Anyang, Henan). The line is schematic.

name.zh: 邺—繁阳亭—洛阳（受禅与定都）

description.zh: 曹丕自邺南下，至颍川繁阳亭受汉献帝禅让，随后定都洛阳。路线示意。
description.en: Cao Pi went south from Ye, accepted Emperor Xian’s abdication at Fanyang Pavilion in Yingchuan, and then made Luoyang the capital. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 阴平—江油—绵竹—成都（邓艾偷渡阴平）

description.zh: 邓艾率偏师自阴平道行无人之地七百余里，破江油、绵竹，直逼成都。路线为示意，阴平道具体走向待考。
description.en: Deng Ai led a detached force along the Yinping trail through seven hundred li of uninhabited country, took Jiangyou and Mianzhu, and closed on Chengdu. The line is schematic and the exact trail is disputed.

name.zh: 武昌—建业（孙权称帝后还都）

description.zh: 孙权在武昌称帝，同年九月迁都建业。路线示意。
description.en: Sun Quan took the throne at Wuchang and moved the capital to Jianye in the ninth month of the same year. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 建业—合肥新城（合肥新城之战）

description.zh: 孙权自建业率十万攻合肥新城，满宠拒守，吴军不克而退。路线示意。
description.en: Sun Quan led 100,000 men from Jianye against Hefei New City; Man Chong held out and the Wu army withdrew. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 成都—僰道—越嶲—泸水—滇池（诸葛亮南征）

description.zh: 诸葛亮率主力自成都南下，经僰道、越嶲，五月渡泸水，深入南中。路线为示意，具体道路与“七擒”地点待考。
description.en: Zhuge Liang led the main force south from Chengdu through Bodao and Yuexi, crossed the Lu river in the fifth month and entered the south. The line is schematic and the exact roads and “seven captures” sites are disputed.

description.zh: 诸葛亮自汉中出散关围陈仓，久攻不克，粮尽退兵。路线示意。
description.en: Zhuge Liang left Hanzhong through Sanguan and besieged Chencang; the siege failed and he withdrew for lack of food. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 王平据兴势险要拒曹爽，费祎自成都率援军。路线示意。
description.en: Wang Ping held the Xingshi defile against Cao Shuang while Fei Yi brought reinforcements from Chengdu. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 建业—濡须口（濡须口之战）

description.zh: 孙权自建业率舟师赴濡须口拒曹操。路线示意。
description.en: Sun Quan led his fleet from Jianye to hold Ruxukou against Cao Cao. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 孙权自濡须口进攻皖城，吕蒙、甘宁破城。路线示意。
description.en: Sun Quan advanced from Ruxukou against Wancheng, which Lü Meng and Gan Ning took. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 寻阳—长沙—益阳（争荆州三郡）

description.zh: 吕蒙自寻阳率军取长沙、零陵、桂阳，关羽入益阳对峙。路线为示意，零陵、桂阳未逐一画出。
description.en: Lü Meng marched from Xunyang to take Changsha, Lingling and Guiyang while Guan Yu moved to Yiyang. The line is schematic; Lingling and Guiyang are not drawn separately.

description.zh: 曹丕自洛阳东巡至广陵，临江观兵而还。路线示意。
description.en: Cao Pi toured east from Luoyang to Guangling, reviewed his army by the Yangzi and withdrew. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 汉中—阴平—狄道（洮西之战）

description.zh: 姜维自汉中经阴平出陇西，大破王经于洮西，进围狄道。路线为示意，具体进军道路待考。
description.en: Jiang Wei marched from Hanzhong through Yinping into Longxi, crushed Wang Jing at Taoxi and besieged Didao. The line is schematic and the exact roads are uncertain.

description.zh: 姜维出祁山，退军时于段谷为邓艾所破。路线示意。
description.en: Jiang Wei marched from Qishan and was defeated by Deng Ai at Duangu while withdrawing. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 司马昭率大军自洛阳东下，围诸葛诞于寿春。路线示意。
description.en: Sima Zhao led the main army east from Luoyang and besieged Zhuge Dan at Shouchun. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 姜维败于侯和，退屯沓中屯田。路线示意。
description.en: Defeated at Houhe, Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong to farm. The line is schematic.

name.zh: 沓中—剑阁（姜维退守剑阁）

description.zh: 姜维自沓中回军，退守剑阁，阻挡钟会主力。路线示意。
description.en: Jiang Wei returned from Tazhong and held Jiange against Zhong Hui’s main force. The line is schematic.

description.zh: 羊祜自洛阳出镇襄阳，经营荆州方向。路线示意。
description.en: Yang Hu went from Luoyang to take command at Xiangyang and build up the Jingzhou front. The line is schematic.
